title: 270 South Twenty-first Street (House), Columbus, Franklin County, OH
notes: Significance: This single family residence is a contributing structure in the Columbus Near East Side Historic District. Although the district is noted for its more opulent residences built between 1880 and 1930, the southwest portion of the district in which this house is located contains very modest two-story frame houses.
